name: Sakurasaku Koro ni...
source:
The main character is a down-on-his-luck private eye who finds a photo on the street.
It shows three women laughing under the cherry blossoms, but on the back, there's a message: "Help me"-signed by Kanako Nanjo...

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ149099.html]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
主角是一位运气不佳的私家侦探，他在街上发现了一张照片。
三个女人在樱花下欢笑，背面却写着南条加奈子签名的“救救我”……

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ149099.html]dlsite[/url]]
